showcase.name: Media Manager
showcase.description: Owner-operated Usenet movie and TV manager with evidence-based indexer selection, one AltMount job per title, Plex-safe symlinks, and exact Plex confirmation.
showcase.longDescription:
Media Manager owns the workflow from a Seerr or manual request through evidence-based Newznab indexer selection, one AltMount download job, read-only output verification, Plex-safe managed symlinks, and exact Plex confirmation.

Requirements: AltMount, Plex, at least one Newznab-compatible indexer, and a TMDB API read access token. Seerr is optional.

The Cosmos app installs the API, UI and PostgreSQL, creates the UI, /api and /health routes on one host, and injects the owner token server-side on /api.
